title: Aspire K2 Replacement Tank
description: The Aspire K2 Replacement Tank is a reliable and versatile option for vapers who prefer a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience. Designed as an accessory for the Aspire K2 Starter Kit, this tank features a durable Pyrex glass construction with stainless steel components for a sleek and durable design. With a 1.8ml e-liquid capacity, the K2 Tank uses Aspire’s Bottom Vertical Coil (BVC) technology and comes pre-installed with a 1.6-ohm Kanthal coil. Paired with organic cotton wicking, the BVC coil ensures consistent performance and clean, full-bodied flavour. The tank’s fixed bottom airflow system enhances flavour delivery while maintaining a tight draw for an authentic MTL experience. Its 510 connection allows compatibility with a variety of devices, although it is optimised for use with the Aspire K2 Battery. Refilling is simple with the bottom-fill design, ensuring hassle-free operation. Whether you’re replacing a worn tank or adding a spare to your vaping kit, the Aspire K2 Replacement Tank delivers reliability, flavour, and ease of use in a compact and stylish form.
